# k0rdent_vpc (Data Source)

One VPC, by name.

Use `k0rdent_vpcs` when the name is not known ahead of time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "k0rdent_vpc" "training" {
  id = "vpc-training"
}

# Empty except on the nico fabric.
output "attached_groups" {
  value = data.k0rdent_vpc.training.security_groups
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The VPC's name. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read. Defaults to the provider's `project`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `backend` (String) Fabric backend serving the VPC. Only a `nico` VPC can carry security groups; on any other backend `security_groups` is always empty and attaching one is refused.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name, for display only.
- `owner_id` (String) UID of the owning cluster or instance group.
- `owner_kind` (String) What created this VPC: a cluster or an instance group. Deleting that owner deletes the VPC.
- `security_groups` (List of String) Ids of the attached security groups, in the order they were last set. Never empty on a `nico` VPC: clearing the binding reinstates the platform's DEFAULT group rather than leaving none.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this VPC.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state. `updating` means a security-group change has been accepted and `security_groups` is what the API will converge on, not necessarily what the fabric enforces yet.
- `ufo_cr_name` (String) The VPC's fabric name. This is the value a cluster-provisioned `k0rdent_network` reports as `vpc`.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_vpcs`](../data-sources/vpcs.md) data source: lists every one.
- [`k0rdent_vpc_peering`](../resources/vpc_peering.md) resource: peers the VPC with another.
- [`k0rdent_vpc_security_groups`](../resources/vpc_security_groups.md) resource: binds security groups to the VPC.
